description: Read the traffic for one of your listings: views, click-outs, votes per day and rank history, inside the window your listing plan allows. Optionally narrow it with from and to (dates). Read-only. Submitting a listing for review is deliberately not available through MCP: it needs a human to pass the Turnstile check in the dashboard.

from.description: YYYY-MM-DD, days before it are left out

to.description: YYYY-MM-DD, days after it are left out

name: get_stats
